collect_task_stats: collect task statistics including histogram data for radio, checkbox, and select form fields across all units
check_task_has_fields_for_stats: check if a task has any form fields suitable for histogram statistics generation
get_unit_data: get unit inputs and outputs from a DataBrowser for a given Unit including final submission data
get_unit_fields_for_histogram: extract form fields of type radio, checkbox, or select from unit inputs for histogram generation
update_data_for_histogram: update histogram data by aggregating field option counts from unit outputs across radio, checkbox, and select fields
